newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Police say child abduction was false alarm.
newsitem.headline: Police say child abduction was false alarm.

text.p: Belgian police on Monday called off a nationwide alert after the suspected abduction of two children turned out to be a false alarm.
Belgian radio had earlier said the children, who were not named, were picked up by a Mercedes delivery van with a German number plate on Sunday.

But it later said the car belonged to the German parents of the children and that the parents -- visiting Belgium for the easter holiday -- had dragged the children into the car because they wanted to keep on playing.
A witness of the incident alerted police, fearing for the safety of the children.
Belgium has been rocked over the past nine months by a child abduction, rape and murder scandal, in which five children have so far been found dead.
